name: Zellweger症候群（軽症型）

summary.text: A variant of intermediate severity of the PBD-Zellweger syndrome spectrum (PBD-ZSS) characterized by hypotonia, leukodystrophy, and vision and sensorineural hearing deficiencies. Phenotypic overlap is seen between NALD and infantile Refsum disease (IRD).
